operation.historicalIntent: one deliberate approved-support-stimulant use tied to a bounded field condition, followed by survival/extraction

decision.reason: The defining product fantasy is stimulant-conditioned operational performance. Vanilla already owns that competency test directly through Jaeger's The Survivalist Path - Junkie, which requires Scav eliminations on Woods while under a stimulant effect. Changing the target count, map, stimulant selector, adding extraction, or reducing required uses does not create a materially distinct Admiral capability; those are parameter variations around the same core mechanic.

vanillaAuthority.definingMechanic: combat eliminations while under a stimulant effect

decision.futureReentryRule: A pharmacology concept may be reconsidered only if it uses a materially different, exactly supported mechanic and passes a fresh vanilla/Artem/Scorpion overlap review plus Economy Admiral supply review.

supersedesPreviousGate.reason: Mechanic proof can no longer rescue a product concept already rejected for semantic collision.
